==================== SECTION 1: QUESTION DETAILS ====================

You are given an integer array [b]A[/b] of length [b]n[/b] and a window size [b]k.[/b]
For every contiguous window of exactly [b]k[/b] elements, its drift score is the number of adjacent pairs inside the window whose values have different parity. Two values have different parity when one is odd and the other is even.
Choose the window with the largest drift score. If several windows have the same maximum score, choose the one with the smallest starting position.
Report the 1-based starting position of the chosen window, its drift score, and the sum of all values inside it.
[b]You are required to debug the following function:[/b]
[code-c]int* LanternWindowDrift(int n, int k, int* A, int* returnSize);[/code][code-cpp]vector&lt;int&gt; LanternWindowDrift(int n, int k, vector&lt;int&gt;&amp; A);[/code][code-java]static int[] LanternWindowDrift(int n, int k, int[] A)[/code][code-python]def LanternWindowDrift(n, k, A):[/code]

The function accepts [b]n, k[/b] and the 0-indexed array [b]A.[/b] It must return a single array of three integers [start, drift, sum]: the 1-based starting position of the chosen window, its drift score, and the sum of its values. In C, the size of the returned array is stored in [b]returnSize.[/b]

[b]Note:[/b][ul][li]Negative values keep their usual parity, so -3 is odd and -4 is even.[/li][li]A window of size 1 has no adjacent pairs, so its drift score is 0.[/li][/ul]
[b]Input Format:[/b][ul][li]The first line contains two integers [b]n[/b] and [b]k.[/b][/li][li]The second line contains [b]n[/b] integers [b]A[1], A[2], ..., A[n].[/b][/li][/ul][b]Input will be read from the STDIN by the candidate.[/b]

[b]Output Format:[/b]
Print the starting position, the drift score and the window sum, each on its own line.
[b]The output will be matched to the candidate&#39;s output printed on the STDOUT.[/b]

[b]Constraints:[/b][ul][li]1 &le; [b]k[/b] &le; [b]n[/b] &le; 1000[/li][li]&minus;10[sup]6[/sup] &le; [b]A&#91;i&#93;[/b] &le; 10[sup]6[/sup][/li][/ul]
[b]Example:[/b]
[b]Input:[/b]
7 4
3 8 5 6 10 7 9
[b]Output:[/b]
1
3
22
[b]Explanation:[/b]
The window [3, 8, 5, 6] changes parity at all three adjacent pairs, so its drift score is [b]3,[/b] the largest possible for [b]k = 4.[/b] It is the earliest such window, starts at position [b]1[/b] and has sum 3 + 8 + 5 + 6 = [b]22.[/b]

[b]Sample Input[/b]
6 3
2 4 7 9 6 8
[b]Sample Output[/b]
1
1
13

{

    //Value in p is printed to STDOUT
    return 0;
}

Suffix:
int* LanternWindowDrift(int n, int k, int* A, int* returnSize)
{
/* Write your code here. */
    int bestStart = 0, bestDrift = -1, bestSum = 0;
    for (int s = 0; s < n - k; s++)
    {
        int drift = 0;
        int sum = A[s];
        for (int j = s + 1; j < s + k - 1; j++)
        {
            if ((A[j] - A[j - 1]) % 2 != 0)
                drift++;
            sum += A[j];
        }
        if (drift > bestDrift)
        {
            bestStart = s + 1;
            bestDrift = drift;
            bestSum = sum;
        }
    }
    int* result = (int*)malloc(3 * sizeof(int));
    result[0] = bestStart;
    result[1] = bestDrift;
    result[2] = bestSum;
    *returnSize = 3;
    return result;
}

vector<int> LanternWindowDrift(int n, int k, vector<int>& A)
{
/* Write your code here. */
    int bestStart = 0, bestDrift = -1, bestSum = 0;
    for (int s = 0; s < n - k; s++)
    {
        int drift = 0;
        int sum = A[s];
        for (int j = s + 1; j < s + k - 1; j++)
        {
            if ((A[j] - A[j - 1]) % 2 != 0)
                drift++;
            sum += A[j];
        }
        if (drift > bestDrift)
        {
            bestStart = s + 1;
            bestDrift = drift;
            bestSum = sum;
        }
    }
    return {bestStart, bestDrift, bestSum};
}

static int[] LanternWindowDrift(int n, int k, int[] A) {
    /* Write your code here. */
    int bestStart = 0, bestDrift = -1, bestSum = 0;
    for (int s = 0; s < n - k; s++) {
        int drift = 0;
        int sum = A[s];
        for (int j = s + 1; j < s + k - 1; j++) {
            if ((A[j] - A[j - 1]) % 2 != 0)
                drift++;
            sum += A[j];
        }
        if (drift > bestDrift) {
            bestStart = s + 1;
            bestDrift = drift;
            bestSum = sum;
        }
    }
    return new int[]{bestStart, bestDrift, bestSum};
}

----- Language: Python -----

Prefix:

Suffix:
def LanternWindowDrift(n, k, A):
    # Write your code here.
    best_start = 0
    best_drift = -1
    best_sum = 0
    for s in range(n - k):
        drift = 0
        total = A[s]
        for j in range(s + 1, s + k - 1):
            if (A[j] - A[j - 1]) % 2 != 0:
                drift += 1
            total += A[j]
        if drift > best_drift:
            best_start = s + 1
            best_drift = drift
            best_sum = total
    return [best_start, best_drift, best_sum]

        int[] A = new int[n];

            A[i] = scan.nextInt();
